snippet.title: Disco Samurai - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Disco Samurai will launch on Steam on November 14, 2025!

You can checkout Disco Samurai and wishlist it at:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2576410/Disco_Samurai/

Disco Samurai is a unique cyberpunk rhythm combat game. Master the art of perfectly timed parries and dodges to throw your enemies off balance and finish them off with devastating counter attacks. Crank up the volume and seize the rhythm of the electrifying soundscape of synthwave and rock!
